tasks.label: Convert PDF to images
tasks.command:
python3 -c "
import subprocess
# Use macOS built-in tool to convert all pages
for pdf in ['offset__ loop.pdf', 'gain_loop.pdf', 'time_skew__ (13).pdf']:
    print(f'Converting {pdf}...')
    outdir = f'/tmp/{pdf.replace(\" \", \"_\").replace(\".pdf\", \"\")}'
    subprocess.run(['mkdir', '-p', outdir])
    result = subprocess.run(['sips', '-s', 'format', 'png', pdf, '--out', f'{outdir}/page_1.png'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='/Users/katsu/Downloads/ADC校准参考文档')
    print(result.stdout)
    print(result.stderr[:200])
"
